judgment.control_rule: Run all M0 viability cases first. For each Q cluster inspect one fresh M0 sample before dispatching the remaining M0 wave. Run H1 only if at least one meaningful pre-registered M0 quality deficit appears while M0 remains viable.
judgment.minimum_samples: Five independent M0 controls and, only after deficit confirmation, five independent H1 samples per cluster.
